framework: static HTML, CSS, and JavaScript; no build step
typography: Geist and Geist Mono from Google Fonts, with system fallbacks
palette: near-black slate surfaces, pale text, phosphor mint accent, restrained amber/red status colors
spacing: tokenized 4px-derived scale with compact controls and generous section rhythm
motion: functional hero demo only; reduced-motion support; content remains visible without JavaScript
components: shared floating navigation, cards, notes, status chips, truth grids, tables, docs sidebar, and statement footer
